column4: New Android features coming to phones and smartwatches
column5: New Android features coming to phones and smartwatches 9 new Android features to help you stay productive Feb 26, 2024 | x.com Facebook LinkedIn Mail Copy link Hear text summaries on the road, easily listen to Spotify between devices and more. John Renaldi Sr. Director, Product and Design, Wear OS by Google & GM, Android Health Share x.com Facebook LinkedIn Mail Copy link Today, we’re rolling out Android updates to help you simplify your day and get more done — whether on your phone, tablet or Wear OS smartwatch or in your Android Auto-compatible car. 1. Stay in touch while focusing on the road With the help of AI, Android Auto can automatically summarize long texts or busy group chats while you’re driving. It will also suggest relevant replies and actions, so you can simply tap once to send a message, share your ETA or start a call. Keep in touch on the road with message summaries and smart actions. 2. Hear AI-generated captions for images With image captions in Lookout on Android, you can listen to auto-generated AI descriptions of photos, online images and pictures included in messages. Designed with blind and low-vision communities, this feature is now rolling out globally in English. 3. Explore around you with more accessible place information Enhanced screen reader support for Lens in Maps helps you explore nearby and identify places like ATMs, restaurants and transit stations. You can now point your phone’s camera at your surroundings and TalkBack will read the place’s information out loud — like its business hours, rating or directions on how to get there. Discover new places with Lens in Maps — now more accessible on Android. 4. Give feedback with handwritten markups in Docs With Google Docs markups, you can now add handwritten annotations to Docs from your Android phone or tablet using just your finger or stylus. With a selection of markup tools to choose from, like different pen colors and highlighters, reviewing documents and providing feedback is fast, flexible and easy. Easily give feedback from your Android phone or tablet. 5. Listen uninterrupted on Spotify with new casting controls The output switcher on Android’s home screen already helps you easily switch between your devices when playing YouTube Music — whether it’s your phone speaker, headphones, smart speakers or TV. Now you can do the same with Spotify. So when you’re playing media on Spotify, the output switcher will now show Spotify Connect devices. Easily switch media between devices for uninterrupted listening. 6. View your health, wellness and fitness data in one place See a more complete picture of your health right in the redesigned Fitbit app through Health Connect — with data from your favorite wearables and apps like AllTrails, Oura Ring and MyFitnessPal. In the Fitbit app on your Android phone, head to the You tab to see data from connected apps next to your Fitbit data. And in the Today tab, you can see data like exercise, steps, calories burned, floors climbed and distance traveled from Health Connect-compatible apps. View a more complete picture of your health and fitness apps — all in one place. 7. For best performance, we recommend the latest version of Android. Follow the instructions to check your version . Android Auto is built into the phone as a technology that enables your phone to connect to your car display. This means you do not have to install a separate app from the Play Store to use Android Auto with your car display. To get more information about your car’s compatibility with Android Auto on your car display, contact your vehicle manufacturer. Check if your car is compatible To use Android Auto on your car display, your car needs to be compatible with Android Auto or have an aftermarket unit installed. Android Auto won't work on all cars equipped with a USB port. See this list of manufacturers to check if your car is compatible. Check your USB cable Not all USB cables will work with all cars. For the best quality and reliability when you connect to Android Auto try a high-quality USB cable. If Android Auto had worked properly before and no longer works now, replace your USB cable and that will likely fix the issue. Here are some tips to help you find the best USB cable for Android Auto: Use a cable that's under 3 feet (1 meter) long and don't use USB hubs or cable extensions. Try the cable that came with your phone. These cables are often tested by the phone manufacturer to make sure they work well with the phone. For example, the Pixel cable should work well with a Pixel phone. The Samsung USB cable should work well with a Samsung Galaxy phone. Cables from independent manufacturers can be a good choice if they meet standards of the USB Implementers Forum. If you want to buy a cable, you can check if it has been certified within the past two years . To find the cable, filter the list for the model number or brand. Check your car or receiver In your car, try these troubleshooting tips: Check to see if Android Auto is turned on in your car's infotainment system. Restart your car's infotainment system. If you’re using an aftermarket receiver, such as a Pioneer or Kenwood unit: Check the manufacturer’s website to see if a firmware update is available. Check your settings if you're connecting to a second car If you're having trouble connecting to a second car: Unplug your phone from the car. Select Menu Settings Connected devices Connection preferences Android Auto Previously connected cars Tap on top right menu Tap on Forget all cars Try plugging your phone into the car again. Make sure the car is compatible with Android Auto and that Android Auto is turned on. Need more help? Digital car key offers enhanced security compared to key fobs, which are vulnerable to relay attacks. This is because digital car key uses a combination of Bluetooth and Ultra Wideband (UWB) technology, or NFC technology, to create a more secure connection between the car and the user's phone. Digital car key isn’t just an app. Its information is securely stored in the hardware of the user’s device. This ensures that it’s safe from tampering and gives you control over who has access to your digital car key. You can also remotely suspend or delete digital car key if it is lost or stolen, unlike lost key fobs which can be used to steal a vehicle. 2 Additionally, there is an option to enable biometrics for added protection on specific features. What happens if my phone battery runs out? You may still be able to unlock and start your car for a few hours after your phone’s battery has run out. How do I share my digital car key? column5: What is IPTV and how does it work? - Airtel Skip to content Explore Airtel Explore Airtel Thanks App X DTH What Is IPTV (Internet Protocol Television) and How Does It Work? June 15, 2022 January 3, 2025 In today’s digital age, the way we consume television content has undergone a significant transformation. Internet Protocol Television (IPTV) has emerged as a popular alternative to traditional cable and satellite television services, offering viewers greater flexibility and a wider range of options. In this blog, we’ll delve into what IPTV is, how it works, and the benefits it offers to consumers. Buy Airtel DTH with exciting benefits What is IPTV? IPTV, or Internet Protocol Television, is a technology that delivers television content over an internet connection instead of traditional broadcast methods like satellite or cable. With IPTV, viewers can access their favourite TV shows, movies, and live events through an internet-enabled device, such as a smart TV, computer, or smartphone. IPTV utilises internet protocol (IP) networks to transmit video content in the form of data packets, which are then decoded and displayed on the viewer’s screen. Read more: The best family shows to watch – Airtel Digital TV How Does IPTV Work? The IPTV system operates by delivering television content through a broadband internet connection, which can be either wired or wireless. Here’s a simplified overview of how IPTV works: Content Sources: IPTV providers acquire television channels and content from various sources, including broadcasters, content producers, and streaming services. Content Encoding: The acquired content is encoded into a digital format compatible with IP networks. This encoding process compresses the video data to optimise bandwidth usage and ensure smooth transmission over the internet. Content Distribution: Once encoded, the video content is distributed over IP networks to IPTV service providers’ servers. These servers act as central hubs for managing and distributing content to subscribers. Subscriber Access: Subscribers access IPTV content through a dedicated IPTV set-top box, smart TV app, or software application installed on their devices. They connect to the IPTV service provider’s servers via their internet connection. Content Decoding and Display: The IPTV client device decodes the received data packets and displays the video content on the viewer’s screen in real-time. Users can navigate through channels, access on-demand content, and interact with additional features provided by the IPTV service. Benefits of IPTV: Flexibility and Convenience: IPTV offers viewers the flexibility to watch their favourite TV shows, movies, and live events anytime, anywhere, using any internet-enabled device. This convenience eliminates the need for traditional cable or satellite TV subscriptions and allows users to customise their viewing experience according to their preferences. Wide Range of Content: IPTV providers offer a diverse range of channels and content options, including live TV, video-on-demand (VOD), catch-up TV, and interactive features such as pause, rewind, and record. This extensive content library ensures that viewers have access to a wide variety of entertainment choices. High-Quality Video Streaming: IPTV delivers high-quality video streaming over broadband internet connections, providing viewers with crisp, clear images and smooth playback. The use of advanced video compression technologies ensures efficient bandwidth usage and minimises buffering or pixelation issues. Interactive Features: IPTV platforms often include interactive features such as electronic programme guides (EPG), on-screen menus, and personalised recommendations based on viewers’ preferences. These features enhance the user experience and make it easier for users to discover new content. Cost-Effectiveness: Compared to traditional cable or satellite TV subscriptions, IPTV services often offer competitive pricing and flexible payment plans. Users can choose from various subscription packages based on their budget and viewing preferences, making IPTV a cost-effective alternative for accessing premium television content. How to Expand an IPTV Platform to Web, Android, iOS, and Smart TV For an IPTV operator, launching a service on just one type of device is rarely enough anymore. With users now watching linear channels on a TV, viewing content on a smartphone, opening catch-up content in a browser, or using an IPTV set-top box as the main screen at home, expanding a service across multiple client platforms is not simply a matter of releasing additional apps. Read more All Content in One Service: Live TV, VoD, Radio, Archive, TimeShift, and EPG in Ministra PRO A television service has long been more than just a list of channels. Viewers now want to watch live broadcasts, return to a missed program, pause a show, schedule recordings of individual episodes or an entire series using nPVR, or choose a movie from a catalog. At the same time, all these capabilities should feel like parts of a single media environment rather than separate systems. Read more IPTV and the Modernization of Hospital Digital Infrastructure Because hospitals operate around the clock, it's essential that their digital infrastructure supports stable departmental operations, data security, internal communications, and patient comfort. As a result, a hospital’s digital infrastructure requires a stricter approach than the infrastructure of a hotel, office, or residential complex. Read more Bulk Purchase of IPTV Hardware A bulk purchase of IPTV hardware is not just a way to reduce the unit price through higher volume. For many operators, integrators, distributors, and those involved with hospitality projects, this method of procurement becomes an essential part of a successful operating model. Read more Low-Code and No-Code Solutions for IPTV: Myth or a New Stage of Automation? IPTV/OTT services are becoming more complex, with operators having to manage not only TV channels, but also VOD, archives, tariffs, devices, user applications, billing, events, statistics, and support. And the more screens and viewing scenarios subscribers use, the more manual operations the operator’s team has to handle. Read more How a TV Operator Can Migrate to IPTV: Architecture, Stages, and Risks The transition from traditional television to IPTV is rarely just about replacing one signal delivery method with another. For an operator, it usually means changing their entire service model, with content being delivered over an IP network, while subscription management, device management, access rights, and interactive features are handled through a software platform. Read more How UI/UX Is Created for TV and Mobile Applications: Customization, White-Label, and Branded Experience in IPTV/OTT The TV and mobile app interface of an IPTV/OTT service is not just its appearance. For the viewer, it determines how easy it is to find a TV channel, open the program guide, continue watching a movie, choose the audio language, go to VOD, or return to the last viewed content. For the operator, the interface becomes part of the product, shaping brand perception, the structure of access to content, and the quality of the user experience. Read more 10 Trends in IPTV and OTT That Will Shape the Market Through 2030 Both the IPTV and OTT markets are changing rapidly, with viewers expecting convenient access to live television, video on demand services, Smart TV apps, personalized recommendations, and stable playback quality across all devices. Subscribe News STREAM, Official Sponsor, at ICT Africa Summit 2026 As the official sponsor of the ICT Africa Summit 2026, STREAM proudly reaffirmed its commitment to building the future of technology in Algeria and across the African continent. Driven by a clear vision of digital transformation, STREAM’s presence at this major event reflects its ambition to promote innovation, local production, and the development of the IT ecosystem. Throughout the summit, STREAM showcased its full range of IT product collections, including Lexus laptops, Alios All-in-One systems, and Lumina monitors, designed to meet both personal and professional needs. A key highlight was the presentation of the first motherboard for laptops manufactured in Algeria, marking a significant milestone in the country’s technological and industrial development. The STREAM booth also welcomed high-level official visits, including the Minister of Post, Telecommunications, Technologies and Digitalization, Mr. Sid Ali Zerrouki, as well as the Minister of Knowledge Economy, Startups and Micro-enterprises, Mr. Noureddine Ouadah. These meetings provided an opportunity to discuss STREAM’s future outlook, particularly in industrial development, expansion of local production, and support for the gaming ecosystem in Algeria. On this occasion, STREAM also highlighted its growing industrial capabilities, following the recent opening of its new production unit, with an annual capacity of 3 million screens. This development further reinforces its commitment to strengthening local manufacturing, contributing to national industrial growth, and advancing technological sovereignty. STREAM also took part in several speaking engagements during the event, including the opening ceremony and ministerial conferences, where it presented its vision and objectives for the future of the technology sector in Algeria. A keynote dedicated to “The Industrial Production of IT Products Made in Algeria” showcased its commitment to building a strong, innovative, and competitive local industry. In addition, STREAM highlighted Bomare Academy through the presentation of its training programs and initiatives aimed at developing local skills and supporting the next generation of digital professionals. The company also participated in the ICT Africa podcast, sharing further insights into its activities, innovation strategy, and future ambitions. Beyond the conference program, STREAM created strong engagement with visitors, partners, and media representatives. Its team provided detailed information about its products and solutions while addressing media interest on site. In parallel, digital content was produced to cover key moments of its participation and provide broader access to important updates. Through its sponsorship and active participation in the ICT Africa Summit 2026, STREAM confirms its key role in promoting innovation, advancing technology, and reinforcing the “Made in Algeria” vision. Our journey towards innovation continues. BOMARE COMPANY announces an industrial partnership with SAIEG SPA, a SONELGAZ subsidiary, for the local production of electronic boards intended for professional use Algiers, October 27, 2025. As part of its industrial and technological development strategy, BOMARE COMPANY announces the establishment of an industrial partnership with SAIEG SPA, a subsidiary of SONELGAZ, a company recognized in the field of electronic engineering and industrial solutions. This collaboration is part of the ongoing efforts of both companies to strengthen their industrial integration and diversify their activities through the production of electronic boards intended for professional applications. It also reflects a broader cooperation approach between public and private Algerian economic players, aimed at enhancing national capabilities and consolidating the country’s industrial fabric in line with public policy orientations. Through this partnership, BOMARE COMPANY reinforces its position as a key player in the Algerian electronics industry and continues its commitment to providing economic operators with industrial solutions that meet international standards, while promoting local value creation and supporting the momentum of national production. This new initiative is fully aligned with BOMARE COMPANY’s vision for sustainable growth, based on the development of local production and the consolidation of a strong, integrated, and competitive Algerian industry—capable of ensuring long-term growth and actively contributing to the country’s economic development. BOMARE COMPANY announces the end of its collaboration with LG Electronics Algeria in the field of television manufacturing After more than a decade of fruitful collaboration, BOMARE COMPANY announces the end of its industrial partnership with LG Electronics, initiated on June 5, 2013, and focused on the manufacturing of LG televisions within BOMARE COMPANY’s production facilities. This decision, made by mutual agreement, results from differing strategic directions and growth dynamics between the two companies, each pursuing its own vision for development and market positioning, both nationally and internationally. Throughout these twelve years of cooperation, BOMARE COMPANY and LG Electronics have maintained an exemplary relationship built on trust, performance, and the transfer of technological know-how. This collaboration has significantly contributed to the growth of the national electronics industry and the upskilling of local teams. Continuing its journey, BOMARE COMPANY is now entering a new phase of growth marked by the launch of new production units and the expansion of its product range. The company is implementing a strategy that combines horizontal development, through the diversification of its product portfolio, and vertical development, by increasing its rate of industrial integration. This dual approach will strengthen its competitiveness and ensure a sustainable presence in international markets. True to its core mission, BOMARE COMPANY continues to pursue its ambition of being a leader in the electronics industry by promoting innovative, high-performance, and nationally produced technology that meets global standards. Since its creation, BOMARE COMPANY has embraced a vision that extends beyond Algerian borders. This international outlook has made it the first Algerian company to export televisions to the European market, a tangible recognition of its expertise, product quality, and ability to adapt to global market requirements. The end of this collaboration thus marks the beginning of a new chapter in BOMARE COMPANY’s journey, one driven by a steadfast commitment to innovation, excellence, and active contribution to the country’s industrial development. В середньому людина 70% вільного часу проводить перед екраном, продивляючи різноманітний контент: фільми, кліпи та інтернет-ролики. Тому так важливо бути впевненими в якості і надійності телевізора, вибираючи даний вид техніки. ERGO пропонує покупцю не просто стильний елемент інтер’єру. Ми пропонуємо широкий асортимент моделей з різною комплектацією та діагоналлю екрана. При цьому всю техніку ERGO об’єднує висока якість і ергономічний дизайн, який чудово пасує до будь-якого інтер’єру. У вітальні, спальній кімнаті або на кухні телевізори ERGO будуть виглядати органічно, створюючи затишок. ERGO пропонує широкий вибір LED телевізорів з різними технічними характеристиками. У нашому асортименті представлені моделі: • З різною діагоналлю екрана (від 19 до 55 дюймів); • З високою роздільною здатністю (HD, UHD, Full HD); • З функцією Smart TV; • З HDMI та USB роз’ємами. Також представлено телевізори в різному ціновому діапазоні. Найкомпактніші моделі не поступаються за якістю і функціональними можливостями телевізорам з широкою діагоналлю екрану. Якщо вам потрібен телевізор для кухні – модель з невеликою діагоналлю та лаконічним дизайном чудово підійде для цього. Повний набір аналогових і цифрових вхідних і вихідних інтерфейсів забезпечує можливість підключення будь-яких додаткових мультимедійних пристроїв. Вбудований ТВ тюнер і функція Smart TV урізноманітнять ваше дозвілля та подарують необмежені можливості в купі з неймовірною якістю трансляції. Всі LED телевізори мають наступні якості: • Лаконічний та ергономічний дизайн; • Реалістичність та чіткість зображення; • Відтворення будь-якого контенту із зовнішніх носіїв; • Сучасна комплектація; • Гарантія від виробника. Ергономічний дизайн телевізорів дозволить вам оптимально використовувати простір квартири чи будинку. Їх можна прикріпити на стіну або встановити на горизонтальній поверхні. Тонкі та стильні, телевізори ERGO прекрасно підійдуть до будь-якого інтер’єру. Надійна та довговічна продукція ERGO прослужить вам не один рік. В разі необхідності, спеціалісти наших сервіс-центрів допоможуть налаштувати чи підключити техніку. Koncové zariadenie ONT Echolife HG850a k službe Optik má dostupné dva porty (LAN3 a LAN4) pre zapojenie Magio Boxov. Ak chcete zapojiť viac ako dva Magio Boxy, je potrebné mať k dispozícii sieťový prepínač SWITCH (poskytuje ho aj Telekom), nie HUB. Základný (nahrávací) Magio Box necháte zapojený v LAN4, SWITCH prepojíte s LAN3 a ďalšie Magio Boxy zapojíte do SWITCHu. Pri koncovom zariadení Vigor postupujete podobne, ale SWITCH zapojíte na port s označením P3. Ak máte v byte len zásuvku bez ďalších zariadení, SWITCH zapojíte priamo na zásuvku. Na Magio Boxe mám USB port, ale nič mi na ňom nefunguje. Prečo? V súčasnej dobe USB port na zariadeniach nie je využiteľný. Je možné vymeniť Magio Box pri predĺžení zmluvy? Nie, pri predĺžení zmluvy je možné len doobjednanie ďalšieho Magio Boxu. Ein TV-Stick, auch als Fernseh-Stick bekannt, ist ein kleines Streaming-Gerät, das Sie einfach in den HDMI-Anschluss Ihres Fernsehers stecken. Damit verwandeln Sie Ihren Fernseher in ein smartes Entertainment-System. Über WLAN greifen Sie auf Live-TV, Streaming-Dienste, Apps und Mediatheken zu – ganz ohne zusätzlichen Receiver. Der MagentaTV Stick (2. Gen.) ist der Streaming-Stick der Telekom. Mit dem Stick können Sie MagentaTV und Streaming-Dienste flexibel auf Ihrem Fernseher nutzen – unabhängig vom Internetanbieter. Alles, was Sie brauchen, ist ein Fernseher mit einem HDMI-Anschluss, eine freie Steckdose und ein WLAN-Internetzugang. Für HD-Wiedergabe empfehlen eine Internetverbindung mit mindestens 16 MBit/s im Download. Wollen Sie Inhalte in 4K Ultra HD genießen, sollten Sie mindestens 25 MBit/s zur Verfügung haben. Magenta TV Stick und Fernbedienung Details Einfach ein guter TV-Stick Der MagentaTV Stick (2. Gen.) kann flexibel an jeden Fernseher mit HDMI-Eingang angeschlossen werden. Einfach mit dem WLAN verbinden und los geht’s. Mit 16 GB bietet der MagentaTV Stick (2. Gen.) ausreichend Speicherplatz für alle relevanten Streaming-Apps. Zudem lässt sich jeder bei MagentaTV buchbare Streaming-Dienst auf Wunsch komfortabel direkt bei der Inbetriebnahme installieren. Neben Full HD werden auch 4K/Ultra HD, HDR, Dolby Vision und Dolby Atmos unterstützt , um zu Hause ein echtes Kinogefühl zu ermöglichen. Tipp: Den doppelten Speicherplatz und eine noch schnellere Performance (insb. beim Starten und Wechseln von Streaming-Apps) gibt es mit der MagentaTV One (2. Gen.) Einfach eine Fernbedienung für Fernsehen & Streaming Die Fernbedienung hat sowohl spezielle Tasten für Fernsehen über MagentaTV als auch Tasten, die für zeitversetztes Fernsehen und Streaming sinnvoll sind. Mit der TV-Taste jederzeit direkt ins laufende TV-Programm schalten. Mit der individuell belegbaren Sterntaste schnell die persönlichen Lieblings-App(s) starten – es sind bis zu 6 installierte Apps konfigurierbar. Mit der Fernbedienung kann ein kompatibler Fernseher ein-/ausgeschaltet und die Lautstärke des Fernsehers geändert werden. Einfach nur noch eine Fernbedienung. Alle direkt abspielbaren Inhalte von MagentaTV sowie von kostenlosen oder gebuchten Partnerdiensten sind mit einem grünen Haken gekennzeichnet. Einfach nach Inhalten suchen und Ergebnisse von MagentaTV und ausgewählten Partnerdiensten (z. B. RTL+, Disney+, Mediatheken) erhalten. So genießen Sie Ihr TV- und Streaming-Erlebnis ganz flexibel, wo immer Sie sind. Häufig gestellte Fragen zum MagentaTV Stick (2. Gen.) Grundsätzliche Fragen zum Stick Was ist der MagentaTV Stick (2. Gen.)? Der MagentaTV Stick (2. Gen.) ist der neue TV-Streaming-Stick der Telekom, mit dem Sie das einzigartige Fernseh-Erlebnis von MagentaTV ganz flexibel auf jedem Fernseher mit HDMI-Eingang genießen können – ganz einfach über WLAN, unabhängig vom Internetanbieter. Perfekt in Kombination mit einem neuen MagentaTV Tarif, wie z. B. dem MagentaZuhause M mit MagentaTV Smart. Was für eine Internetleitung wird benötigt? Für MagentaTV und Fernsehen in HD empfehlen wir eine Internetverbindung mit min. 10 MBit/s im Download. Für 4K Ultra HD und HDR (z. B. auf Netflix) sollten min. 25 MBit/s im Download zur Verfügung stehen. Was ist im Lieferumfang des MagentaTV Sticks (2. Gen.) enthalten? Der MagentaTV Stick (2. Gen.) wird mit einer Bluetooth Fernbedienung, einem Netzteil sowie einer gedruckten Bedienungsanleitung ausgeliefert. Was sind die technischen Voraussetzungen für den MagentaTV Stick (2. Gen.)? Alles, was Sie für die Nutzung des Fernseh-Sticks brauchen, ist ein Fernseher mit einem HDMI-Anschluss, eine freie Steckdose und einen WLAN-Internetzugang. Wir empfehlen mindestens 10 MBit/s im Download für HD-Wiedergabe. Der MagentaTV Stick (2. Gen.) unterstützt HDMI 2.1 mit HDCP 1.4 sowie HDCP 2.3 und läuft mit Android TV™. Voraussetzung für die Nutzung des MagentaTV Sticks ist die Zustimmung zu den Google Nutzungsbedingungen, zur Google Datenschutzerklärung sowie zu den Google Play Nutzungsbedingungen. Die Nutzung bestimmter Google Dienste (z. B. Google Play Store) setzt ein Google Konto voraus. Voraussetzung für die Nutzung von MagentaTV mit dem MagentaTV Stick (2. Gen.) ist ein neuer MagentaTV Tarif (buchbar seit 15.02.2024, aktuelle Preise unter telekom.de/magenta-tv ). Was ist der Unterschied zwischen dem MagentaTV Stick (2. Gen.) und dem Vorgängermodell? Der MagentaTV Stick (2. Gen.) ist ausschließlich auf das neue MagentaTV ausgerichtet und optimiert worden, daher ist er ausschließlich mit den neuen MagentaTV Tarifen (buchbar seit 15.02.2024) kompatibel. Indessen ist das Vorgängermodell auch mit älteren MagentaTV Tarifen (ab Ende 2020) kompatibel. Der MagentaTV Stick (2. Gen.) hat eine deutlich bessere Fernbedienung als das Vorgängermodell. Um mehr Apps installieren zu können, hat der MagentaTV Stick (2. Gen.) doppelt so viel Speicherplatz erhalten (16 GB statt zuvor 8 GB) und darüber hinaus unterstützt das neue Modell nun Wi-Fi 6 und Bluetooth 5 während das Vorgängermodell nur bis einschließlich Wi-Fi 5 und Bluetooth 4.2 unterstützt. Was ist der Unterschied zwischen dem MagentaTV Stick (2. Gen.) und der MagentaTV One (2. Gen.)? Der MagentaTV Stick (2. Gen.) bietet den einfachen Einstieg ins MagentaTV Erlebnis, während die MagentaTV One (2. Gen.) als Premium-TV Box für ein überragendes MagentaTV Erlebnis sorgt. So ist die MagentaTV One (2. Gen.) deutlich leistungsstärker und schneller als der MagentaTV Stick (2. Gen.), insbesondere beim Starten von Apps sowie beim Navigieren. Zudem bietet die MagentaTV One (2. Gen.) den doppelten Speicherplatz und ermöglicht somit die Installation von deutlich mehr Apps als der MagentaTV Stick (2. Gen.). Zusätzlich zur flexiblen WLAN-Anbindung ermöglicht die MagentaTV One (2. Gen.) durch einen integrierten LAN-Anschluss und ein beigelegtes LAN-Kabel ein noch besseres Streaming-Erlebnis. Darüber hinaus hat nur die Premium Fernbedienung der MagentaTV One (2. Gen.) beleuchtete Tasten – eines der beliebtesten Features. Ist der MagentaTV Stick mit älteren MagentaTV Tarifen kompatibel? Nein, der MagentaTV Stick der 2. Generation funktioniert nur mit den neuen MagentaTV Tarifen, die seit dem 15. Februar 2024 verfügbar sind. Der MagentaTV Stick der 1. Generation ist dagegen mit älteren Tarifen (ab Ende 2020) kompatibel. Der neue Stick hat doppelt so viel Speicherplatz und unterstützt Wi-Fi 6, während das ältere Modell nur Wi-Fi 5 und Bluetooth 4.2 nutzt. Abonnement und Kosten Welcher MagentaTV Tarif wird für den MagentaTV Stick (2. Gen.) benötigt? Voraussetzung für die Nutzung von MagentaTV mit dem MagentaTV Stick (2. Gen.) ist ein neuer MagentaTV Tarif (buchbar seit 15.02.2024, aktuelle Preise unter telekom.de/tv ). Kann ich den MagentaTV Stick (2. Gen.) auch ohne Telekom Anschluss nutzen? Um MagentaTV mit dem MagentaTV Stick (2. Gen.) zu erleben, brauchen Sie nicht zwingend einen DSL-Anschluss bei der Telekom. Diesen Streaming Stick nutzen Sie über WLAN – unabhängig von Ihrem Internetanbieter. Voraussetzung für die Nutzung von MagentaTV mit dem MagentaTV Stick (2. Gen.) ist ein neuer MagentaTV Tarif (buchbar seit 15.02.2024). Weitere Infos finden Sie unter MagentaTV . Rund um die Nutzung des Sticks Was für Optionen zur Steuerung des MagentaTV Sticks (2. Gen.) habe ich? Neben der im Lieferumfang enthaltenden Fernbedienung lässt sich der Stick auch via Sprachsteuerung des Magenta Sprachassistenten sowie des Google Assistant oder durch Einbindung eigener Bluetooth Gamepads steuern. Aber auch die Anbindung einer USB-Tastatur ist möglich. Wie kann ich den Magenta Sprachassistenten auf meinem MagentaTV Stick (2. Gen.) nutzen? Einfach die Mikrofon-Taste der Fernbedienung drücken und sagen, was der Magenta Sprachassistent bei MagentaTV machen soll, z. B. „Suche die Tagesschau“, „Schalte auf RTL“, „Öffne Netflix“ u.v.m. Alle Sprachbefehle Funktioniert der MagentaTV Stick (2. Gen.) nur bei mir zu Hause? Nein, der MagentaTV Stick (2. Gen.) bietet Ihnen in Kombination mit einem neuen MagentaTV Tarif (buchbar seit 15.02.2024) in der gesamten EU beste Unterhaltung! Welche Streaming-Dienste, Mediatheken und Apps sind über den MagentaTV Stick (2. Gen.) verfügbar? Neben MagentaTV sind RTL+, Disney+, Netflix, Prime Video, YouTube, WOW, DAZN, MagentaSport, Apple TV, Paramount+, Joyn, ARD Mediathek, ZDF Mediathek, und viele weitere Dienste verfügbar. Über den Google Play Store sind Tausende Apps verfügbar. Wie nehme ich mit dem MagentaTV Stick (2. Gen.) auf und wie groß ist der Aufnahmespeicher? Mit der Buchung von MagentaTV stehen Ihnen bis zu 100 Stunden Cloud-Speicher zur Verfügung (bei MagentaTV Basic und MagentaTV Flex bis zu 50 Stunden). Sendungen, die Sie in Ihrem Cloud-Recorder speichern, können Sie über Ihren MagentaTV Stick (2. Gen.) sowie Ihr Smartphone, Tablet oder PC/Laptop überall und jederzeit ansehen. Auf dem MagentaTV Stick (2. Gen.) können Sie Aufnahmen direkt über die Fernbedienung programmieren. Alternativ können Sie Aufnahmen über Ihr Smartphone, Tablet oder PC/Laptop programmieren. Technisches und Details Der MagentaTV Stick (2. Gen.) basiert auf dem Betriebssystem Android TV. Was bedeutet das für mich? Der MagentaTV Stick (2. Gen.) basiert auf dem Betriebssystem Android TV von Google und hat bereits diverse Google Dienste (z. B. Google Play Store, Google Assistant) integriert, so dass die Zustimmung zu den Google Nutzungsbedingungen, zur Google-Datenschutzerklärung sowie zu den Google Play Nutzungsbedingungen erforderlich ist. Die Nutzung bestimmter Google Dienste (z. B. der Google Play Store) setzt ein Google-Konto voraus. Wie viel Strom verbraucht der MagentaTV Stick (2. Gen.) und was für eine Stromquelle wird benötigt? Der MagentaTV Stick (2. Gen.) verbraucht im Betrieb unter 5W, im Standby-Modus unter 3W. Als Stromquelle reicht jede herkömmliche Steckdose. Das passende Netzteil für den Stick ist im Lieferumfang enthalten. Wie stabil läuft der Magenta TV Stick bei schwachem WLAN? Bei schwachem WLAN kann es sein, dass das Bild ruckelt oder zeitweise aussetzt. Für flüssiges Streaming brauchen Sie eine stabile Internetverbindung mit mindestens 16 MBit/s. So können Sie die Verbindung verbessern: Platzieren Sie den Stick näher am Router. Schalten Sie andere Geräte im WLAN vorübergehend aus. Verwenden Sie bei Bedarf einen Adapter für eine LAN-Verbindung. Verstärken Sie das Signal Ihres Routers durch einen WLAN-Repeater. Starten Sie Stick, Fernseher und Router neu, wenn weiterhin Störungen auftreten. Wie installiere ich eine neue App auf meinem MagentaTV Stick (2. Gen.)? Sie können weitere Apps über den Google Play Store installieren. Den Google Play Store finden Sie unter dem Menüpunkt Apps. Für die Installation weiterer Apps benötigen Sie ein Google-Konto. Welche Netzwerk Standards unterstützt der MagentaTV Stick (2. Gen.)? An Wi-Fi-Standards werden Wi-Fi (W-Lan) mit 2,4GHz und 5GHz (IEEE 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac/ax 2x2 Dualband) mit WPA/WPA2/WPA3 unterstützt. Eine Anbindung via LAN-Kabel ist mit einem USB-LAN-Adapter möglich. LAN-Kabel und Adapter sind nicht im Lieferumfang enthalten und müssen separat erworben werden. Der Stick kann auf Anwendungen aus dem PlayStore zugreifen. Kann ich z. B., wenn ich ein Spiel installiere, den Stick mit einem Bluetooth Game Controller verbinden, um dieses zu spielen? Ja, Bluetooth- und USB-Controller können an den MagentaTV Stick (2. Gen.) angeschlossen werden. Allerdings können wir nicht für alle Modelle Kompatibilität garantieren. Ist der MagentaTV Stick HDR-kompatibel? Ja, HDR10, HDR10+, HLG sowie Dolby Vision. Jelajahi Pertanyaan Apa itu IndiHome? IndiHome adalah layanan digital yang menyediakan internet rumah, telepon rumah, dan TV interaktif (MAXStream TV) dengan beragam pilihan paket. Saat ini jaringan IndiHome sudah tersebar di seluruh wilayah Indonesia dan terus berinovasi untuk memenuhi kebutuhan internet yang lebih baik bagi masyarakat. Apa saja Add-On IndiHome? Add-on adalah berbagai layanan tambahan yang tersedia di IndiHome dan bisa diaktifkan oleh pelanggan sesuai kebutuhan dan keinginan. Bagaimana cara registrasi IndiHome? Kunjungi tsel.id/nasional dan selesaikan tiap tahapan registrasi hingga selesai. Jika proses registrasi sudah berhasil terkonfirmasi, tunggu maksimal 3x24 jam untuk pemasangan layanan. Apakah IndiHome pindah ke Telkomsel? Ya, mulai 1 Juli 2023 layanan IndiHome secara resmi bergabung menjadi bagian dari Telkomsel. Apakah kelebihan IndiHome setelah dialihkan ke Telkomsel? Dengan mengintegrasikan layanan IndiHome yang menawarkan koneksi internet tetap melalui serat optik serta dengan jaringan seluler broadband yang luas, memungkinkan pelanggan IndiHome dan Telkomsel untuk mendapatkan pengalaman konektivitas broadband yang mulus dan pengalaman digital yang lebih baik di dalam maupun di luar rumah, tanpa terikat pada satu teknologi jaringan tertentu. Ke depannya, Telkomsel juga akan mengembangkan beragam penawaran produk dan layanan yang lebih terjangkau dan bernilai tambah, yang mengintegrasikan seluruh keunggulan, baik layanan fixed broadband IndiHome maupun layanan mobile broadband Telkomsel, seperti Orbit, Telkomsel PraBayar, dan Halo. Apakah pelanggan lama IndiHome harus daftar ulang ke Telkomsel? Tidak, pelanggan IndiHome yang dialihkan ke Telkomsel tidak perlu melakukan daftar ulang, layanan IndiHome yang digunakan akan terdaftar dalam pengelolaan Telkomsel. Apakah ada perubahan cara bayar (nomor rekening/bank)? Tidak ada perubahan cara pembayaran billing/tagihan IndiHome setelah IndiHome bergabung dengan Telkomsel. Apakah ada perubahan produk/tarif layanan IndiHome? Tidak ada perubahan paket produk/tarif layanan IndiHome setelah IndiHome bergabung dengan Telkomsel. Pelanggan akan mendapatkan informasi secara berkala jika terdapat perubahan atau penawaran produk lebih lanjut. Apakah billing/tagihan IndiHome akan disatukan dengan tagihan Telkomsel? Billing/tagihan IndiHome saat ini belum disatukan dengan Telkomsel Halo. Kami akan menginformasikan apabila ada perubahan tagihan IndiHome dan Telkomsel. Benefit HVC IndiHome masih dapat digunakan sesuai syarat dan ketentuan yang berlaku. Saat ini masih belum ada penggabungan segmen HVC IndiHome dan Telkomsel. Saat ini telah hadir paket Telkomsel One, sebagai penawaran bundling antara fixed broadband dan mobile. Apakah aplikasi myIndiHome akan digabung dengan MyTelkomsel? Saat ini layanan IndiHome dapat dikelola melalui aplikasi MyTelkomsel. Pelanggan dapat login aplikasi MyTelkomsel menggunakan nomor IndiHome yang dimiliki. Anda akan mendapatkan informasi tentang pengalihan layanan IndiHome ke Telkomsel melalui kontak yang Anda gunakan saat registasi (Email/WhatsApp/SMS) atau bisa menghubungi layanan pelanggan IndiHome. Bagaimana jika saya tidak mau pindah ke Telkomsel, apa yang harus saya lakukan? Anda dapat menyampaikan lebih lanjut mengenai kendala yang dihadapi melalui layanan pelanggan IndiHome untuk diteruskan ke unit terkait. Apakah ada perubahan bentuk tagihan IndiHome? Perubahan tagihan IndiHome mengakomodasi peralihan layanan IndiHome dari Telkom ke Telkomsel berlaku pada 1 Agustus 2023. Apa saja yang berubah dari tagihan IndiHome? Secara prinsip tagihan IndiHome by Telkomsel berisi informasi yang sama dengan tagihan sebelumnya namun dengan perubahan format, pencatuman NPWP/NIK pelanggan, pencantuman periode pemakaian, pencantuman tanggal tagihan, dan penerbitan bukti pembayaran di periode tagihan berikutnya (disertai penerapan meterai elektronik untuk pembayaran lebih dari Rp5 juta). Apakah tagihan Indihome by Telkomsel berlaku sebagai Faktur Pajak? Tagihan IndiHome berlaku sebagai Faktur Pajak dengan nomor tagihan/invoice sebagai nomor Faktur Pajak. Untuk kemudahan identifikasi periode, tagihan IndiHome akan mencantumkan tanggal tagihan sesuai akhir bulan pemakaian. column5: Everything Google built-in for your Renault vehicle search order find a retailer contact us my account menu openR link with Google built-in your vehicle with Google built-in Renault vehicles equipped with the openR link multimedia system seamlessly integrate Google apps 7 and services for a connected driving experience 9 : voice control with Google Gemini*, navigate with Google Maps, voice control with Google Assistant and download your favourite apps on Google Play. *Google, Google Play, Google Maps, Waze and other brands are trademarks of Google LLC. Google built-in is dependant on vehicle version & model. Gemini and Gemini Live, your helpful Al assistant from Google will be available in a future update as an upgrade to Google Assistant. A Google Account signed into the car is required to access Google Gemini.Some connected apps require setup. Compatibility and availability vary. 18+. Google Maps navigate with confidence using real-time traffic updates and natural, conversational help find out more Google Assistant stay focused on the road and control vehicle features using just your voice find out more Gemini an AI assistant built into your vehicle for natural, fluid conversations find out more Google Play your favourite apps can be downloaded and used from the dashboard find out more Google Maps latest-generation navigation Log on to your Google account at openR link to access your favourite addresses and your history, directly on the central screen. your journeys in real time With Google Maps built-in to openR link, you can take the best route to your destination, with traffic information updated in real time. Advice is provided in the event of any disruption to your journey. always up to date With the navigation performance of Google Maps and the constant evolution of the openR link system, your maps are always up to date. You can take to the road with complete peace of mind and accuracy with no surprises. customised navigation Personalise your navigation with your favourite addresses, your history and suggested itineraries when signed into your Google Account Google Maps sent to car Send the planned route directly from your smartphone's Google Maps app to your Renault's openR link multimedia system. Users must use the same Google account in the vehicle and in the Google Maps app to perform this operation. dynamic route planner The dynamic route planner lets you change the stops on your current route or adjust your stops along the way to your final destination. ​ Google Maps will optimise your new route by taking into account: your battery charge level, your preferences regarding charging station capacity, and points of interest. eco-friendly trip planner Google Maps offers an eco-friendly route for all types of vehicles, whether gas-powered or electric. This option lets you choose routes optimised for fuel efficiency and helps you reduce the carbon footprint of your trip. By choosing an eco-friendly route, you can not only save money on fuel but also help reduce carbon emissions. drivers' traffic reports Google Maps allows drivers to report incidents, receive alerts, and vote on existing reports in real time while on the road. Drivers can report eight types of incidents, such as accidents, speed cameras, and traffic jams. The availability of each type of incident is subject to local legal and regulatory restrictions. weather-based route planner Google Maps' new navigation feature lets you choose safer routes during winter weather events. Google Maps will avoid directing you to unpaved country roads and forest trails during severe weather conditions, opting instead for priority roads that are often monitored and plowed.​ Google Maps, which is connected to real-time weather data, will help you avoid small secondary roads that could become impassable during snowfall or heavy rain optimised electric journey planning Google Maps has it all: the charging stations on your route and the duration of your stops. Once on the road, it continues to adapt in real time, recalculating your route according to your energy consumption, traffic conditions and preferences. easy charging arrival With the integration of artificial intelligence into Google Maps, locating charging stations is easier. As you approach your charging station, Google Maps provides photos and descriptions of the station. charging station reliability with the Google community Drivers share their thoughts on their charging experience directly from their vehicles. Google Maps uses this feedback to show how reliable the charging stations are. charging speeds at stations on the map The charging speeds of the stations are indicated on the map by icons, ranging from “Slow” to “Super Fast”. This allows you to quickly identify charging stations and choose the one that best suits your needs. availability of charging stations upon arrival Google Maps displays an estimate of the charging stations that will be available upon your arrival, for charging stations connected in real time. real-time planning Charging points, traffic jams, disruptions on the road, battery temperature, driving range - your route is planned, updated and recalculated throughout your journey. All your journeys are organised and optimised. customised travel Enter your usual charging points (such as your home and/or workplace), specify the type of charging you're interested in (fast or standard) and mention your preferred method of payment, and your system will automatically personalise your journeys. proactive system By default, Google Maps suggests suitable charging points and plans an optimised route. You can then modify it according to your preferences by changing the order of the stops or replacing them with others: Google Maps adapts in real time, as often as you like. pre-conditioned battery By planning your journeys with Google Maps, the battery will be pre-conditioned to bring it up to an ideal temperature, allowing you to charge faster and optimise your itinerary. Google Assistant voice control with Google Assistant* Make calls, play your music, find your route, and more – all with just your voice. Enjoy a safe, intuitive experience while staying focused on the road. Just say, "Hey Google" to get started. control vehicle functions Talk to Google Assistant to control your vehicle get information on range and plan your journeys. 9 Google Assistant makes life on board your Renault easier. *depending on vehicle, version and equipment level; some controls are only available in certain languages Google Assistant every day To help you get the most out of your travels and your day, Google Assistant provides information and support on a range of topics. For example, say: "Hey Google, set the temperature to 21 °C." "Hey Google, turn on the recirculating air." "Hey Google, what's the latest news?" "Hey Google what is the current temperature?" And Google Assistant responds and does what's necessary. multi-sense driving modes Your driving experience changes in just a few words. For example, say: "Hey Google, switch to ECO mode." "Hey Google, switch to sport mode!" And that’s it. keep an eye on your battery With Google Assistant, you'll always know the status and range of your battery. For example, say: "Hey Google, what is my battery level at?" "Hey Google, how long can I drive for?" "Hey Google, can I reach SFO?" And Google Assistant responds. planned routes Get behind the wheel and ask Google Assistant to plan your journey. For example, say: "Hey Google, how’s the traffic to work?" "Hey Google, take me home." "Hey Google, where is the closest charging station?" let the system guide you voice-controlled solarbay panoramic roof Google Assistant for using solarbay. For example, say: "Hey Google, open the front solarbay." "Hey Google, lighten the sunroof." "Hey Google, lighten the panoramic roof." And Google Assistant adjusts your solarbay. stay connected and entertained With voice control from Google Assistant, you can stay focused on the road while having fun. multimedia control Music, podcasts, radio, streaming: Google Assistant helps you use your apps and the multimedia system. For example, say: "Hey Google, put on the rnlt© music lounge playlist by Renault." "Hey Google, play the radio." manage your contacts Stay in touch with friends and family without taking your eyes off the road: ask Google Assistant to make your calls and read or write your messages. For example, say: "Hey Google, message Dad." "Hey Google, read my messages." "Hey Google, call the medical centre." stay organised while on the go Well-organised days, quick answers and practical home automation: Google Assistant voice commands let you remotely control your connected smart home appliances from your Renault. your agenda organised Want to take stock of your appointments? Create a to-do list? Ask Google Assistant. For example, say: "Hey Google, what's on my agenda today?" "Hey Google, create a list called {To Do}." "Hey Google, remind me to buy bread at 7pm." discover nearby places Organise your breaks by asking Google Assistant to point you in the direction of nearby shops. For example, say: "Hey Google, ABC Coffee Shop opening hours." "Hey Google, show me coffee shops open now." your connected smart home devices Use Google Assistant to control your connected smart home devices from your Renault while on the go. For example, say: "Hey Google, open my garage door." "Hey Google, set the temperature at home to 20°C." "Hey Google, turn on the lights at home." The 2026 Nautilus Hybrid was also named Best Luxury Hybrid SUV in U.S. News & World Report's 2026 Best Hybrid and Electric Cars awards. Is the 2026 Lincoln Nautilus a plug-in hybrid or electric vehicle? No, the 2026 Lincoln Nautilus® SUV is not a plug-in hybrid or electric vehicle. It's available with a standard 2.0L turbocharged gas engine or an available hybrid powertrain. Neither requires plug-in charging. The hybrid system recharges through regenerative braking and the gas engine. What is the towing capacity of the 2026 Lincoln Nautilus? The 2026 Lincoln Nautilus® SUV has a maximum towing capacity of 1,750 lbs when properly equipped with the dealer-installed Class I Trailer Tow Package. * Maximum tongue weight is 175 lbs, with a trailer frontal-area limit of 20 sq ft. This capacity applies to both the standard and hybrid powertrains across all trims. Does the 2026 Lincoln Nautilus come with BlueCruise hands-free highway driving? Yes, the 2026 Lincoln Nautilus® is equipped with BlueCruise with Automatic Lane Change and In-Lane Repositioning with four years included on every trim, 127 with a complimentary four-year Connected Service plan. BlueCruise enables hands-free highway driving on 97% of controlled access highway across the U.S. and Canada. These areas are called hands-free Blue Zones. How big is the display in the 2026 Lincoln Nautilus? The 2026 Lincoln Nautilus® SUV comes standard with a 48-inch panoramic display spanning the full width of the dashboard, paired with an 11.1-inch center display. Both house the Lincoln Digital Experience * with integrated Google™ apps and services (including Google Maps™, Google Gemini™ AI assistant, and Google Play™) ** and provide a customizable interface for the driver and front passenger. Google, Android, Android Auto, Google Maps and other marks are trademarks of Google LLC. Does the 2026 Lincoln Nautilus have massage seats? Yes, the 2026 Lincoln Nautilus® SUV offers available Perfect Position front seats with Active Motion® massage functionality. These 24-way power-adjustable seats feature multiple massage programs and are integrated into the available Lincoln Rejuvenate, * which coordinates Ambient Lighting, display visuals, seat positioning, and available Digital Scents ** to help create a more relaxing experience inside your vehicle. Massage seats are available on Reserve models with the Reserve III Package and standard on Lincoln Black Label™ † models. How much cargo space does the 2026 Lincoln Nautilus have? The 2026 Lincoln Nautilus® SUV offers up to 71.2 cu ft of total cargo space with the second-row seats folded on Premiere models. * Reserve and Lincoln Black Label™ ** models offer up to 68.8 cu ft behind the first row due to interior configurations. With the second row upright, cargo volume is 36.4 cu ft (Premiere) or 35.2 cu ft (Reserve/Black Label). Does the 2026 Lincoln Nautilus have a third row? No, the 2026 Lincoln Nautilus® SUV is a two-row midsize luxury vehicle that seats five passengers. For a Lincoln SUV with third-row seating, the Lincoln Aviator® SUV offers seating for up to seven, and the Lincoln Navigator® SUV seats up to eight. What is the safety rating of the 2026 Lincoln Nautilus? The Lincoln Nautilus® SUV earned an IIHS TOP SAFETY PICK+ award with "Good" ratings across all crashworthiness categories, including small overlap front, moderate overlap front, and updated side impact tests. NHTSA awarded a 5-star * overall frontal crash rating and a 5-star overall side impact rating. What does the 2026 Lincoln Nautilus warranty cover? The 2026 Lincoln Nautilus® SUV includes a four-year/50,000-mile bumper-to-bumper warranty and a six-year/70,000-mile powertrain warranty. * Additional coverage includes: Five-year unlimited-mileage corrosion (perforation) coverage Five-year/60,000-mile safety restraint coverage 24/7 Roadside Assistance for the duration of ownership 10 Eight-year/100,000-mile hybrid-unique component coverage (hybrid models) What's the difference between the Lincoln Nautilus and the Lincoln Aviator? The 2026 Lincoln Nautilus® SUV is a two-row midsize SUV, while the 2026 Lincoln Aviator® SUV is a larger three-row model. Key differences: Seating: Nautilus seats five across two rows. Aviator seats up to seven across three rows. Powertrain: Nautilus offers a 2.0L turbo four-cylinder or an available hybrid. Aviator is powered exclusively by a twin-turbocharged V6 producing 383 horsepower * (no hybrid option). Display: Nautilus comes standard with a 48-inch panoramic display not available on the Aviator. You will then have access to this offline map data for use of navigation features. To ensure map data is always available, turn on “auto-download” in the Privacy Center. You can also ask Google Assistant to complete certain vehicle functions, such as playing the radio. Google Play cannot be used to download or update apps if connectivity is not available. (MME) Connected Car Services Your Mitsubishi, Your Control Every new Mitsubishi connects to the Mitsubishi Motors app through Connected Car Services. These services enable remote vehicle monitoring and control of key vehicle functions directly from your smartphone, anytime and anywhere, giving you greater control and peace of mind. Wish to cool down your Outlander PHEV remotely after a hike on a hot summer day? Schedule charging for your Eclipse Cross EV so it’s ready for your family vacation? Or simply locate your Grandis or ASX in a busy parking lot? The Mitsubishi Motors app has you covered. The Mitsubishi Motors App We want our drivers to experience things they have never before experienced. So we'll continue to support your ambition to challenge yourself and broaden your life. How can we do that? By improving our cars with innovative technology and engineering craftsmanship. We also do it by ensuring our electric vehicles deliver a superior driving experience. And finally, by intelligently integrating new technologies to deliver exciting and revolutionary vehicles. Google Play App Store Seamless Connectivity Experience Smartphone Display Link Audio Wireless Apple CarPlay® and Android Auto™ make it easy to access your smartphone’s most important apps, features, and information directly on the Smartphone Display Link Audio (SDA), your vehicle’s infotainment screen. Google built-In (Eclipse Cross EV, Grandis and ASX) Mitsubishi Motors has partnered with Google to bring the best of Google’s apps and services to your vehicle, including Google Maps. Discover vehicle features with ease, engage in natural AI-powered conversations with Google Gemini, and find your favourite driving-optimised apps through the Google Play Store. Visit your local Mitsubishi Motors dealer or country website to find out more. Our Network FAQ What is MITSUBISHI CONNECT? MITSUBISHI CONNECT is a platform of services that provide vehicle owners with a safe, secure and convenient driving experience. MITSUBISHI CONNECT is provided through a simple, subscription-based service that is comprised of the following components: • An embedded Telematics Control Unit equipped with a mobile modem and GPS capability that operates on a mobile network and is factory-installed within the vehicle. • Mitsubishi Motors app that can be downloaded through the app store on a compatible Apple or Android smartphone. The Services work using wireless communication networks and the Global Positioning System (“GPS”) satellite network. Services are subject to mobile and GPS network availability and may not work in remote or enclosed areas. The area in which you are driving may affect the service that we can provide to you, including but not limited to routing and GPS services such as our ability to determine your vehicle’s precise location. In addition, using the Mitsubishi Motors app, you can have remote control of the vehicle from your smartphone, such as remote climate and remote charging functions. Which vehicles are equipped with MITSUBISHI CONNECT? MITSUBISHI CONNECT is available on the following vehicles: • 2025 model year and newer Mitsubishi Eclipse Cross BEV, Outlander PHEV, Grandis and ASX vehicles in Europe. What Packages and Services are included in MITSUBISHI CONNECT and the Mitsubishi Motors App? MITSUBISHI CONNECT includes the following features, depending on year, model. Note that services are subject to change. Vehicle Status Services Navigation Services Remote Services Location Services EV Services • Battery State of Charge (SoC) • EV Range • Remote Charge Control • Plug-in Reminder Where are MITSUBISHI CONNECT Services Available? MITSUBISHI CONNECT services are available on Mitsubishi vehicles equipped with the service. Services are available in the following countries and locales. *Coverage areas [MK3.1]are subject to change without any prior notice. • Austria • Belgium • Czech Republic • Denmark • Finland • France • Germany • Hungary • Iceland • Italy • Netherlands • Norway • Poland • Portugal • Romania • Slovakia • Slovenia • Spain • Sweden • Switzerland How to use the Remote features? How to Remotely Turn On the Lights You can turn your vehicle lights on and off remotely by using the Mitsubishi Motors app. To function properly, the engine must be off and the alarm must not be actively sounding. If you choose to turn on the lights: • The lights will keep flashing on for 15 seconds. How to Remotely Sound the Horn You can sound your car’s horn remotely by using the Mitsubishi Motors app. This feature can be useful in helping you to locate your vehicle. To function properly, the engine must be turned off and the alarm must not be actively sounding. How to View the Vehicle Status Report The vehicle status report is a digital snapshot that can retrieve status information from your vehicle. The information retrieved includes: • General vehicle status information, such as odometer reading and total range[WK4.1][HH4.2]. How to Use the Car Finder Feature The Car Finder feature allows you to locate your vehicle.[HH5.1][HH5.2] Please confirm that you are in an area with good connectivity and your privacy mode is disabled. Until now, repeating an AI task — like asking for ingredient substitutions to make a recipe vegan — meant re-entering the same prompt as you visited different pages. To make this easier, we’re launching Skills in Chrome, which lets you save and reuse your most helpful AI prompts and run them with a single click. Build your own one-click workflows When you write a prompt that you’ll want to use again, you can save it as a Skill directly from your chat history. The next time you need it, select your saved Skill in Gemini in Chrome by typing forward slash ( / ) or clicking the plus sign ( + ) button, and your Skill will run on the page you’re viewing, along with any other tabs you select. You can edit your saved Skills and create new ones at any time. Early testers have used Skills in Chrome to create personalized and powerful workflows for a wide range of tasks. Health & Wellness: quickly calculating protein macros for any recipe Shopping: generating side-by-side spec comparisons across multiple tabs Productivity: scanning lengthy documents for important information Get started with our Skills library We’re also launching a library of ready-to-use Skills for common tasks and workflows. Want to break down the ingredients of a product you’re viewing online? Or select the perfect gift from multiple options by cross-referencing your budget with the recipient’s interests? We wrote Skills that do these things and more. If you find one that looks interesting, you can add it as a saved Skill and give it a try. And if you want to customize it to better fit your needs, you can edit the Skill and update the prompt. Stay in control Skills are built on Chrome’s foundation of security and privacy, and they utilize the same safeguards we apply to prompts in Gemini in Chrome. That means a Skills prompt will ask for confirmation before taking certain actions, such as adding an event to your calendar or sending an email. And Skills benefit from Chrome’s layered protections, including automated red-teaming and auto-update capabilities. Starting today, we’re rolling out Skills to Gemini in Chrome on desktop 1 , helping you streamline your AI-powered browsing. Tip: When you close a window, it doesn’t move to the inactive tab and you can't restore it. Search your tabs You can find your opened tabs in the tab switcher. If you have several open tabs, you can search your tabs. On your Android tablet, open Chrome . Next to the address bar, tap Switch tabs . On the upper right, tap Search . On the "Search your tabs" field, enter the tab name you want to find. Other than your open tabs, you can also find your: Recently closed tabs Other devices tabs Search suggestions When you tap a search suggestion, the keyword opens as a search result in Google Search. If your search doesn’t have an exact match, suggestions will display. On your keyboard, to find results, tap Enter . Tap the tab you want to open. Tips: You can search and select a tab from your other devices. In Incognito mode, you can also search tabs on your Incognito tabs. Before you type a tab name, you can find your last 5 opened tabs as suggestions. If no results are found, you can find search suggestions. Highlight and perform bulk actions on multiple tabs Important: This feature is available only on Android tablets and laptops. To organize your tabs, you can highlight multiple tabs to group, move, drag to a new window, or close as one: On your Android device, open Chrome . To highlight multiple tabs, touch and hold the tabs. If you have a mouse: To select specific tabs: Press Ctrl and select each tab you want to add. To select a range of tabs: Select the first tab, press Shift , and select the last tab. This highlights the entire range, along with the active tab. If you don’t have a mouse: Press F6 twice Ctrl + Shift + H . To perform bulk actions, touch and hold any of the highlighted tabs. If you have a mouse, you can right-click any of the highlighted tabs. Tap an action: Add tabs to group Move tabs to another window Close Tip: If you encounter any issues when you highlight multiple tabs, deselect and select them again. This help content & information General Help Center experience Close Next Help Center Community Google Chrome Download and install Google Chrome You can download and install the Chrome web browser at no charge, and use it to browse the web. Check system requirements to use Chrome Windows To use Chrome on Windows with Intel processor or ARM processor, you need: Intel processor: Windows 10 and up. Intel Pentium 4 processor or up that's SSE3 capable. ARM processor: Windows 11 and up. Mac To use Chrome on Mac, you need macOS 13 Ventura and up. Linux To use Chrome on Linux, you need: 64-bit Ubuntu 18.04+, Debian 10+, openSUSE 15.5+, or Fedora Linux 39+. x86-64 devices: An x86-64 processor that's SSE3 capable. ARM devices: 64-bit ARM CPUs. How to install Chrome Important: Before you download, check if Chrome supports your operating system and you’ve met all other system requirements. Windows On your computer, download the installation file . To install the file, follow the on-screen instructions. If you get the message "Do you want to run this file?," select Run . If you get the message "Do you want to allow this app to make changes to your device?," select Yes . Open Chrome. For Windows 10 and up, when the installation is complete, a Chrome window opens. You can make Chrome your default browser . Tip: If you've used a different browser, like Firefox, you can import your settings into Chrome . Install Chrome offline If you have issues when you download Chrome on your Windows computer, use the alternate link to download Chrome on a different computer. On your computer, download a Chrome installer for a different computer. At the bottom of the page, under “Chrome Family,” select Other Platforms . Select the OS of the device you wish to install Chrome on. Download the file. Move the file to the computer where you want to install Chrome. To install, follow the on-screen instructions. Mac On your computer, download the installation file . Open the file named "googlechrome.dmg." On the window that opens, you can find Chrome. Drag Chrome to the Applications folder. You may have to enter the admin password. If you can’t enter the admin password, drag Chrome to a location where you have full permissions, such as your desktop. Tip: To clean up after you install, in the Finder's sidebar, next to “Chrome,” select Eject . Linux Install and use Chrome on Linux To install Chrome, use the same software that installs programs on your computer. You must enter the administrator account password. On your computer, download the installation file . For Debian/Ubuntu: Select the x86-64 .deb package or the arm64 .deb package (for arm64 CPUs). For Fedora/openSUSE: Select the x86-64 .rpm package or the arm64 .rpm package (for arm64 CPUs). To open the package, select Install . Enter your administrator password. When you launch Chrome for the first time, you must review and accept the Google Terms of Service . Tip: To make sure Chrome stays up-to-date, it’s added to your package manager. When security updates are available, Chrome notifies you. Chromebook Chrome comes preinstalled on all new Chromebooks. Learn how to set up your Chromebook . Googlebook Chrome comes preinstalled on all new Googlebooks. Learn how to set up your Googlebook . This help content & information General Help Center experience Close Next Help Center Community Google Chrome Manage Chrome safety and security For a more private and secure browsing experience, you can use Chrome’s safety features, like Safety Check and Safe Browsing. Compromised passwords If you notice an unfamiliar activity on your account or think that your password may have been compromised, change your password immediately. Learn how to secure a compromised Google Account . To change your password from another site, follow the instructions in Chrome. Learn how to manage passwords . Safe Browsing protection levels With Google Safe Browsing, you get alerts about malware, risky extensions, phishing or sites on Google’s list of potentially unsafe sites. Learn how to choose Safe Browsing protection level . Automatic Chrome updates To make sure you're protected by the latest security updates, when available, Chrome can automatically update to the newest browser version. Learn how to update Chrome . On-device encryption for passwords Important: Make sure you’ve already set up on-device encryption. Learn how to set up on-device encryption . Once on-device encryption is set up, you can use your Google password or the screen lock for compatible phones or tablets to unlock your password. This type of encryption means that only you have the key to unlock your passwords. Run a Safety Check on an Android device Chrome runs Safety Check automatically to help you find and fix privacy and security problems. You can review your Chrome's privacy and security with Safety Check. Safety Check searches for: Compromised, reused, or weak passwords: To ensure your online security, Safety Check can warn you if a username or password stored in the Google Password Manager was involved in a data breach. Learn more about how Chrome protects your passwords . Safe Browsing status: To ensure you’re protected against malware, phishing, and other risks, Safety Check can occasionally remind you to review your Safe Browsing settings. Learn more about Safe Browsing protection in Chrome . Available Chrome updates: To ensure that you’re protected by the latest security updates, Safety Check can occasionally remind you to update Chrome. Potentially unwanted notifications: From time to time, Chrome will remind you to review your notification permission grants. Unused site permissions: To protect your data, Chrome removes permissions from sites you haven't used recently. Abusive notifications: Notification permissions are removed by Chrome from sites that Google Safe Browsing finds to be deceiving users into granting the permission. On your Android device, open Chrome . At the top right, tap More Settings . Tap Safety check . If Chrome finds any issues: Tap the item with the issue. Follow the on-screen instructions. Tip: When Safety Check takes action, Chrome will notify you if there are issues that need your attention. These messages will show up on your new tab page. You can select the item with the issue and follow the on-screen instructions. Turn on Always use secure connections When a website’s URL has HTTPS, it can indicate a secure connection. Connections to sites that use HTTPS are more secure than those that don’t. When you turn on Always use secure connections, Chrome upgrades URLs to use HTTPS and displays a warning before you visit a site that doesn’t support it. On your Android device, open Chrome . At the top right, tap More Settings Privacy and security . Under “Security,” turn on Always use secure connections . Select your preferred configuration: Warns you for insecure public sites: Does not warn you for private sites, like your company's intranet. Warns you for insecure public & private sites: Warns you for both public sites and private sites, like your company's intranet. Tip: When you’re about to load a site that doesn’t use HTTPS in its URL, you'll find a “Not Secure” warning in the address bar. Turn on Warn you if a password was compromised in a data breach On your Android device, open Chrome . At the top right, tap More Settings Privacy and security . Under “Security,” turn on Warn you if a password was compromised in a data breach . Use a secure connection to look up a site’s IP address When you visit a site, Chrome looks up the site’s host server’s IP address. To protect your privacy and security, if secure Domain Name System (DNS) lookup is turned on, Chrome encrypts your information during the lookup process. By default, secure DNS in Chrome is turned on in automatic mode. If Chrome has issues looking up a site in this mode, it'll look up the site in the unencrypted mode. You can select a custom provider. When you select a custom provider, Chrome won't default to unencrypted mode. If you have issues, like error messages, you can check your provider setting or turn secure DNS off. The error messages may say that the server’s IP address couldn't be found. Important: If your device is managed or parental controls are turned on, you can’t use Chrome’s secure DNS feature. To turn secure DNS on or off: On your Android device, open Chrome . At the top right, tap More Settings Privacy and security . Under “Security,” tap Use secure DNS . Turn on or off Use secure DNS . Select your current or another service provider. Manage V8 security settings Important: To improve site performance, V8 optimizations are turned on by default. For additional security but reduced site performance, you can turn off the “V8 optimizer.” On your Android device, open Chrome . At the top right, tap More Settings Privacy and security . Under “Security,” tap Javascript optimization and security . Turn off Javascript optimization and security . Tips: You can also specify which URLs can use the V8 optimizer. To add the URL of websites that are allowed or not allowed to use V8 optimizer, tap Add site exception . In the “Site settings,” you can also turn off the "V8 optimizer." Android Advanced Protection mode in Chrome You can help protect Chrome browser on your Android device with Android Advanced Protection. This feature is designed to reduce the number of potential entry points for attackers, helping keep your data more secure. Understand Android Advanced Protection settings On your Android device, open Chrome . At the top right, tap More Settings Privacy and security . Tap Android Advanced Protection is on . Tips: The following Chrome settings are controlled by Android Advanced Protection: Always use secure connections: This feature is turned on and "Warns you for insecure public & private sites" is selected. To ensure safer browsing, Chrome automatically uses HTTPS for all website connections whenever possible. Android Safe Browsing: To block phishing attacks from new malicious websites, “Android Safe Browsing Live Threat Protection” is turned on. JavaScript optimization and security: When Advanced Protection is on, “JavaScript optimizations” are turned off. You can turn Advanced Protection on or off in your device’s Settings app. Learn how to turn off device protection .
